== Summary ==
Identified: none. The player at the tournament desk wears a black Players Committee polo, a dark-green New Era cap, glasses, and a long beard (a different cap and shirt from the green Salt & Ness cap and navy tee in [[:File:2022 Endor Grand Prix 25.jpg]]). The whiteboard quotes C. Wirfs; that name is not a pictured identification. Faces unlabeled.
The [[2022 Endor Grand Prix]] in Seattle, Washington (8–10 April 2022).
